artifacts.waf_bypass: WAF on /api/products?category= blocks (case-insensitive substring): UNION, OR, and comment tokens (-- and #). It ALLOWS SELECT, AND, subqueries. Also a rate limiter (429) — pace requests ~5-6s apart. Bypass: no comments; balance quotes so the app's trailing quote closes cleanly (e.g. ...WHERE x<>''). Use AND + subqueries with SELECT for boolean-blind extraction (no UNION, no OR). App wraps input as WHERE category='<INPUT>'. Any DB exception is masked as "SQL syntax error near: <input>".
artifacts.endpoint_map: /api/login = 404 (decoy listing). /api/account = GET+PATCH+OPTIONS, needs "Authorization: Bearer <token>", junk token => {"error":"invalid token"}. PATCH is the mass-assignment vector (set role=admin). /api/admin/fetch = GET only, "admin only" (SSRF target, ?url=). /api/admin/report = "admin only" (SSTI target, POST name/template). /api/legacy = GET, always {"error":"legacy subsystem error 0x5f — retry"}. /api/debug = decoy flag. Shared rate limiter (429) across all endpoints — pace ~6s. Chain: SQLi->token -> GET/PATCH /api/account role=admin -> admin/fetch or admin/report -> flag.
